supersedes.reason: Version 2 byte-binds every reducer artifact and hardens public prediction authorization before outcome access.

perturbation_system: ex vivo LPS or anti-CD3/CD28 immune stimulation; not CRISPR
donor_split_rule: ascending SHA256('pbmc-citeseq-coupling-v1' + canonical Donor_of_Origin); first six development, final four held
primary_grid: eligible matched RNA-ADT marker-contrast pairs with four Helmert coordinates for one frozen stimulus-lineage contrast per entity; at least 12 entities spanning at least 12 unique marker clusters
marker_rule: sealed alias-table lookup only, with no token fallback and unique case-normalized RNA and alias gene symbols; thresholds fitted per marker-lineage from pooled development baseline cells; distinct cuts and at least 5% occupancy in every RNA and ADT state in every development donor baseline and stimulus arm; the same pairing-independent marginal support in every held donor arm before prediction
state_rule: per-marker-lineage RNA and ADT tertiles fitted only on pooled development-donor baseline cells from that lineage; thresholds applied unchanged to the corresponding development stimulus and held baseline/stimulus arms
entity_graph: unique-marker scGPT hyperedges containing each marker and its six nearest distinct eligible marker genes, plus frozen contrast and lineage hyperedges; membership control permutes gene incidence among whole marker clusters while preserving contrast and lineage incidence exactly
donor_aggregation: equal-weight mean of donor-specific contrasts; inverse-permutation-variance weights enter the structured loss, not donor averaging
common_endpoint: per-cell multinomial deviance on each held stimulus joint table; no held joint pairing is opened during prediction; after coordinates are public, score opens the common held baseline anchor, reconstructs all tables from identical held stimulus margins while stimulus pairing remains sealed, then opens stimulus pairing once; residual inversion uses a fixed floor of 10^-3 times the mean held-table cell count
classical_baselines: full 3x3 Pearson independence-residual matrix, direct and identically structured
full 3x3 signed Poisson-deviance independence-residual matrix, direct and identically structured
primary_gate: pooled held coupling-field correlation marker-bootstrap 95% CI lower endpoint greater than zero
positive coupling-field correlation in every held donor
primary-minus-identically-structured-destroyed per-cell deviance marker-bootstrap 95% CI upper endpoint below zero
primary-minus-best-classical per-cell deviance marker-bootstrap 95% CI upper endpoint below zero

primary-minus-best-matched-field per-cell deviance marker-bootstrap 95% CI upper endpoint below zero, reselecting direct, zero, variance-scalar, nuclear, hypergraph, endpoint, covariance, and membership-permuted methods within each draw
no support, six-neighbor graph, centering, IPF, or optimization refusal
bootstrap_unit: complete matched RNA-ADT marker cluster retaining all eligible contrast pairs
inference_scope: intervals condition on the deposited development and held donors; no population-level donor inference
held_pairing_invariance: prediction is invariant to any within-donor, condition, and lineage permutation of held ADT cell pairing because held eligibility and predictor inputs use separate margins only
seal_scope: public code-path seal in a shared prediction/scoring checkout; not a blinded enclave and not registry-hosted preregistration
structural_exclusions: HTO multiplets, empty droplets, and the IgM/IgG HTO condition
CD3_CD28:CD14_Mono because the stimulated arm is structurally absent
CD3_CD28:NK because one donor has seven baseline cells
non-CD14 LPS lineages because they are outside the frozen targeted-lineage grid

ambiguous RNA-ADT matches, including CD45RA and CD45RO because gene-level PTPRC counts do not resolve those isoform epitopes, and prespecified development or pairing-independent held marginal-support failures

confirmation_family.execution_rule: execute and report both scoreable candidates without stopping after a pass
confirmation_family.familywise_rule: each intersection-union gate uses one endpoint of a two-sided 95% interval (one-sided alpha 0.025); Bonferroni over two scoreable candidates bounds familywise alpha at 0.05
